Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Install from the UI (Recommended, Desktop App & Web UI)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Open the **Plugins** page in the DSH sidebar → click **Add plugin** → type `dsh-zen-remote` → click "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"**Enable now** when the install finishes, then restart the DSH desktop app (or `dsh web`)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Install from the CLI (Headless `dsh web` server)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> `dsh plugin` requires `--profile` to name the target profile. The desktop app's `desktop` profile "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"is managed exclusively by the app (`--profile desktop` is refused on the CLI), so use the UI install"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" above on the desktop app."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 5. Features"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Mobile PWA UI (Host)**: two-level page stack (session list home + session page with swipe-back a"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"nd Android back-gesture support, first-frame boot skeleton, immutable asset caching), auto-discovere"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"d plugin entry chips, compact mobile composer with bottom sheets and phone attachment uploads, and a"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" session info card (6-tile stats with `tok/s` output speed, log export, rename, fork, archive, one-t"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ap full-conversation PNG share image, and remote access switch).
- **Unified Setup Wizard & Headless"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" CLI (`dsh-zen-remote`)**: top-of-page 2×2 live overview card, 3-step modal wizard, and a full-featu"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"red terminal CLI (`setup` / `status` / `host` / `client`) covering all four host ingress modes (Mana"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ged Caddy, Existing Reverse Proxy, Cloudflare Tunnel, LAN / Tailscale Direct with private-IP wall) a"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"nd client pairing.
- **Cross-Desktop Remote Sessions & Multi-Server Pool (Client)**: connect up to *"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"*8 main servers** simultaneously in pairing order; supports full history & live streaming, approval/"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"question sync, per-server isolated model catalog, file tree & Git diffs, duplex server-side terminal"},{"id":"p16s12","text":" (`terminal/attach`), inline Markdown image & media forwarding, windowed artifact downloads, server-"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"side LibreOffice PDF preview, up to 500 MiB file uploads (drag-and-drop, paperclip picker, and paste"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"), and one-click redacted diagnostics export.
- **Plugin Bridge**: cooperative plugins and built-in "},{"id":"p16s15","text":"adapters (such as `dsh-better-sidebar` `0.25.0`–`0.30.1`) route their panel HTTP and WebSocket reque"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"sts in remote sessions to the host machine (with explicit owner consent for whole-machine data). See"},{"id":"p16s17","text":" Plugin Bridge Guide."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"In depth: Interface Design · Public Access & Relay Protocol"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 7. Security Model, Version Tolerance & Known Notes"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Trusted client & strict session isolation**: a paired desktop client runs terminals and file pre"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"views as the host's OS user, while unshared sessions are strictly filtered and refused at the relay "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"layer. Even when binding `0.0.0.0` for LAN/Tailscale, the gateway's private-IP wall rejects any unpr"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"oxied public internet IP (`403 public-direct-forbidden`), and all admin/wizard mutations are restric"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ted to the host machine itself.
- **Version tolerance**: both ends must run the same `dsh-zen-remote"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"` version; DSH host versions may differ (interface fingerprints are compared at handshake and degrad"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"e only mismatched panels)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Expand security & state-file details, known limitations, iOS PWA notes & adapted third-party plugins"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Data & state files**
- The plugin reports nothing to any third party. Pairing state lives in `~/.d"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"sh/lan-gate-state.json`; the unified state file `~/.dsh/zen-remote-state.json` (`0600`) carries the "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"local `serverId`, the shared-session table `sessions`, and the client's paired servers list `servers"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"` (up to 8 servers, tokens included); Cloudflare tokens live in `0600` files under `~/.dsh/zen-remot"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ervers, tokens included); Cloudflare tokens live in `0600` files under `~/.dsh/zen-remote-ingress/`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Known limitations**
- With multiple DSH windows open simultaneously on a client, active-session de"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"tection may occasionally dismiss a closed session early.
- Switching between different servers or re"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"creating a workspace with the same ID requires reloading the client page once.
- "Export session" an"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"d server-local OS dialogs ("Reveal in Finder" / "Open in app") are hidden in remote sessions.
- DSH'"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"s own Settings RPCs are loopback-only by upstream design, so plugin settings must be edited on the m"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"achine running DSH rather than through a remote browser."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**iOS standalone PWA notes**
- **iOS 26.x viewport shrinkage**: home-screen PWAs may lose a status-b"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ar height at the bottom (an iOS WebKit bug); three mitigation layers are built in, and restarting th"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"e PWA restores full height.
- **iOS 26+ top progressive blur**: opening from the home screen may sho"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"w a system `WKScrollPocket` blur across the top ~95px; entering any session and navigating back to t"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"llPocket` blur across the top ~95px; entering any session and navigating back to the list clears it."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
